objects.content: Commands, sample strings, paths, registry keys, mutexes, named pipes, task/service names and other non-IOC artifacts are stored in artifacts.csv.

These scoped names are research and correlation aids. They are not native Intrusion Set aliases and must not be used alone to merge OpenCTI entities.
